# TRAIN

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# K-MEANS + DISTANCE-TO-CENTROID ON SUPERMARKET

lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines),
  basket = lines
)

dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)

long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  )

long_data_clean <- long_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

slow_threshold <- quantile(long_data_clean$time, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

basket_data <- long_data_clean %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_time_per_item = sd(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_time = max(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_time = min(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    range_time = max(time, na.rm = TRUE) - min(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    cv_time = ifelse(mean(time, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                     sd(time, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
                     NA_real_),
    price_per_second = ifelse(sum(time, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                              sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
                              NA_real_),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_price = min(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_price = sd(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_3_price_share = {
      p <- sort(price, decreasing = TRUE)
      if (sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        sum(head(p, 3), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    long_pause_count = sum(time > slow_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max_price / total_price, NA_real_)
  )

dept_share <- long_data_clean %>%
  count(transaction_id, department, name = "dept_items") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    dominant_department_share = max(dept_items) / sum(dept_items),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(dept_share, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    department_diversity_ratio = unique_departments / total_items,
    items_per_second = ifelse(total_time > 0, total_items / total_time, NA_real_),
    items_per_department = total_items / unique_departments
  )

model_time <- lm(avg_time_per_item ~ total_items, data = basket_data)
model_price <- lm(total_price ~ total_items, data = basket_data)

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    expected_time_given_size = predict(model_time, newdata = basket_data),
    time_deviation = avg_time_per_item - expected_time_given_size,
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = basket_data),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )

# FEATURES FOR K-MEANS

kmeans_train <- basket_data %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    total_time,
    avg_time_per_item,
    sd_time_per_item,
    range_time,
    cv_time,
    price_per_second,
    sd_price,
    max_price_share,
    top_3_price_share,
    unique_departments,
    dominant_department_share,
    department_diversity_ratio,
    items_per_second,
    items_per_department,
    time_deviation,
    price_deviation,
    long_pause_count
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_time_per_item = replace_na(sd_time_per_item, median(sd_time_per_item, na.rm = TRUE)),
    range_time = replace_na(range_time, median(range_time, na.rm = TRUE)),
    cv_time = replace_na(cv_time, median(cv_time, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_per_second = replace_na(price_per_second, median(price_per_second, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_price = replace_na(sd_price, median(sd_price, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_price_share = replace_na(max_price_share, median(max_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    top_3_price_share = replace_na(top_3_price_share, median(top_3_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    dominant_department_share = replace_na(dominant_department_share, median(dominant_department_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    department_diversity_ratio = replace_na(department_diversity_ratio, median(department_diversity_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)),
    items_per_second = replace_na(items_per_second, median(items_per_second, na.rm = TRUE)),
    items_per_department = replace_na(items_per_department, median(items_per_department, na.rm = TRUE)),
    time_deviation = replace_na(time_deviation, median(time_deviation, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_deviation = replace_na(price_deviation, median(price_deviation, na.rm = TRUE)),
    long_pause_count = replace_na(long_pause_count, 0)
  )

X_kmeans_raw <- kmeans_train %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_kmeans <- scale(X_kmeans_raw)

# FIT K-MEANS

set.seed(123)
k <- 8

kmeans_model <- kmeans(
  X_kmeans,
  centers = k,
  nstart = 20,
  iter.max = 100
)

# cluster assignment
kmeans_train$cluster_id <- kmeans_model$cluster

# distance to assigned centroid
centers <- kmeans_model$centers

assigned_distances <- map2_dbl(
  split(as.data.frame(X_kmeans), seq_len(nrow(X_kmeans))),
  kmeans_model$cluster,
  ~ {
    row_vec <- as.numeric(.x[1, ])
    center_vec <- centers[.y, ]
    sqrt(sum((row_vec - center_vec)^2))
  }
)

kmeans_train$distance_to_centroid <- assigned_distances

# optional: cluster sizes
cluster_sizes <- table(kmeans_model$cluster)

kmeans_train <- kmeans_train %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_size = as.numeric(cluster_sizes[as.character(cluster_id)])
  )

# FINAL OUTPUT ON SUPERMARKET

basket_kmeans <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(
    kmeans_train %>%
      select(transaction_id, cluster_id, cluster_size, distance_to_centroid),
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    distance_to_centroid_01 = percent_rank(distance_to_centroid)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(distance_to_centroid))

top_150_kmeans_distance_train <- basket_kmeans %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_kmeans_distance_train$total_items)
summary(top_150_kmeans_distance_train$total_price)
summary(top_150_kmeans_distance_train$avg_time_per_item)
summary(top_150_kmeans_distance_train$distance_to_centroid)
summary(top_150_kmeans_distance_train$cluster_size)

top_150_kmeans_distance_train %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_time_per_item,
    unique_departments,
    cluster_id,
    cluster_size,
    distance_to_centroid
  ) %>%
  head(20)

write.csv(
  top_150_kmeans_distance_train,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_kmeans_distance_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
summary(top_150_kmeans_distance_train$total_price)
summary(top_150_kmeans_distance_train$avg_time_per_item)
summary(top_150_kmeans_distance_train$cluster_size)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

                     sd(time, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),

    price_per_second = ifelse(sum(time, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                              sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
                              NA_real_),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_price = min(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_price = sd(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_3_price_share = {
      p <- sort(price, decreasing = TRUE)
      if (sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {

case13_dept_share <- case13_long %>%

case13_basket <- case13_basket %>%

case13_basket <- case13_basket %>%

X_case13_raw <- kmeans_case13 %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

  center = attr(X_kmeans, "scaled:center"),
  scale = attr(X_kmeans, "scaled:scale")
)

# DISTANCE TO NEAREST CENTROID

centers <- kmeans_model$centers

case13_distances <- apply(X_case13, 1, function(row_vec) {
  dists <- apply(centers, 1, function(center_vec) {
    sqrt(sum((row_vec - center_vec)^2))
  })
  min(dists)
})

case13_clusters <- apply(X_case13, 1, function(row_vec) {
  dists <- apply(centers, 1, function(center_vec) {
    sqrt(sum((row_vec - center_vec)^2))
  })
  which.min(dists)
})

cluster_sizes <- table(kmeans_model$cluster)

kmeans_case13$cluster_id <- case13_clusters
kmeans_case13$cluster_size <- as.numeric(cluster_sizes[as.character(case13_clusters)])
kmeans_case13$distance_to_centroid <- case13_distances

# FINAL PURE K-MEANS DISTANCE OUTPUT

case13_kmeans <- case13_basket %>%
  left_join(
    kmeans_case13 %>%
      select(transaction_id, cluster_id, cluster_size, distance_to_centroid),
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    distance_to_centroid_01 = percent_rank(distance_to_centroid)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(distance_to_centroid))

top_150_kmeans_distance_case13 <- case13_kmeans %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_kmeans_distance_case13$total_items)
summary(top_150_kmeans_distance_case13$total_price)
summary(top_150_kmeans_distance_case13$avg_time_per_item)
summary(top_150_kmeans_distance_case13$distance_to_centroid)
summary(top_150_kmeans_distance_case13$cluster_size)

writeLines(as.character(top_150_kmeans_distance_case13$transaction_id))

write.csv(
  top_150_kmeans_distance_case13,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_kmeans_distance_case13.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# IF + CLASTERING TRAIN 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(isotree)

# TRAIN DATA

lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines),
  basket = lines
)

dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)

long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  )

long_data_clean <- long_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

slow_threshold <- quantile(long_data_clean$time, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

# BASKET DATA

basket_data <- long_data_clean %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_time_per_item = sd(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_time = max(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_time = min(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    range_time = max(time, na.rm = TRUE) - min(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    cv_time = ifelse(mean(time, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                     sd(time, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
                     NA_real_),
    price_per_second = ifelse(sum(time, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                              sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
                              NA_real_),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_price = min(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_price = sd(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_3_price_share = {
      p <- sort(price, decreasing = TRUE)
      if (sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        sum(head(p, 3), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    long_pause_count = sum(time > slow_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max_price / total_price, NA_real_)
  )

dept_share <- long_data_clean %>%
  count(transaction_id, department, name = "dept_items") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    dominant_department_share = max(dept_items) / sum(dept_items),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(dept_share, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    department_diversity_ratio = unique_departments / total_items,
    items_per_second = ifelse(total_time > 0, total_items / total_time, NA_real_),
    items_per_department = total_items / unique_departments
  )

model_time <- lm(avg_time_per_item ~ total_items, data = basket_data)
model_price <- lm(total_price ~ total_items, data = basket_data)

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    expected_time_given_size = predict(model_time, newdata = basket_data),
    time_deviation = avg_time_per_item - expected_time_given_size,
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = basket_data),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )

# IF TRAIN

if_train <- basket_data %>%
  select(
        transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    total_time,
    avg_time_per_item,
    sd_time_per_item,
    price_per_second,
    max_price,
    max_price_share,
    unique_departments
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_time_per_item = replace_na(sd_time_per_item, median(sd_time_per_item, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_per_second = replace_na(price_per_second, median(price_per_second, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

X_train_raw <- if_train %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_train <- scale(X_train_raw)

if_model <- isolation.forest(
  as.matrix(X_train),
  ntrees = 300,
  sample_size = 512,
  ndim = 1,
  nthreads = 1
)

if_train$if_score <- predict(
  if_model,
  as.matrix(X_train),
  type = "score"
)

# K-MEANS TRAIN

kmeans_train <- basket_data %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    total_time,
    avg_time_per_item,
    sd_time_per_item,
    range_time,
    cv_time,
    price_per_second,
    sd_price,
    max_price_share,
    top_3_price_share,
    unique_departments,
    dominant_department_share,
    department_diversity_ratio,
    items_per_second,
    items_per_department,
    time_deviation,
    price_deviation,
    long_pause_count
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_time_per_item = replace_na(sd_time_per_item, median(sd_time_per_item, na.rm = TRUE)),
    range_time = replace_na(range_time, median(range_time, na.rm = TRUE)),
    cv_time = replace_na(cv_time, median(cv_time, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_per_second = replace_na(price_per_second, median(price_per_second, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_price = replace_na(sd_price, median(sd_price, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_price_share = replace_na(max_price_share, median(max_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    top_3_price_share = replace_na(top_3_price_share, median(top_3_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    dominant_department_share = replace_na(dominant_department_share, median(dominant_department_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    department_diversity_ratio = replace_na(department_diversity_ratio, median(department_diversity_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)),
    items_per_second = replace_na(items_per_second, median(items_per_second, na.rm = TRUE)),
    items_per_department = replace_na(items_per_department, median(items_per_department, na.rm = TRUE)),
    time_deviation = replace_na(time_deviation, median(time_deviation, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_deviation = replace_na(price_deviation, median(price_deviation, na.rm = TRUE)),
    long_pause_count = replace_na(long_pause_count, 0)
  )

X_kmeans_raw <- kmeans_train %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_kmeans <- scale(X_kmeans_raw)

set.seed(123)
k <- 8

kmeans_model <- kmeans(
  X_kmeans,
  centers = k,
  nstart = 20,
  iter.max = 100
)

kmeans_train$cluster_id <- kmeans_model$cluster
centers <- kmeans_model$centers

assigned_distances <- map2_dbl(
  split(as.data.frame(X_kmeans), seq_len(nrow(X_kmeans))),
  kmeans_model$cluster,
  ~ {
    row_vec <- as.numeric(.x[1, ])
    center_vec <- centers[.y, ]
    sqrt(sum((row_vec - center_vec)^2))
  }
)

kmeans_train$distance_to_centroid <- assigned_distances

cluster_sizes <- table(kmeans_model$cluster)

kmeans_train <- kmeans_train %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_size = as.numeric(cluster_sizes[as.character(cluster_id)])
  )

# FINAL TRAIN SCORE

basket_if_kmeans_train <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(
    if_train %>% select(transaction_id, if_score),
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    kmeans_train %>%
      select(transaction_id, cluster_id, cluster_size, distance_to_centroid),
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    if_score_01 = percent_rank(if_score),
    distance_to_centroid_01 = percent_rank(distance_to_centroid),
    combined_ik_score =
      0.50 * if_score_01 +
      0.50 * distance_to_centroid_01
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(combined_ik_score))

top_150_if_kmeans_train <- basket_if_kmeans_train %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_if_kmeans_train$if_score)
summary(top_150_if_kmeans_train$distance_to_centroid)
summary(top_150_if_kmeans_train$total_items)
summary(top_150_if_kmeans_train$total_price)

write.csv(
  top_150_if_kmeans_train,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_if_kmeans_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# CASE14: IF + K-MEANS DISTANCE TEST

```{r}

case15_lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/case15.csv", warn = FALSE)

case15_raw <- tibble(
  raw_line = case15_lines
) %>%
  mutate(
    transaction_id = stringr::str_extract(raw_line, "(?<=Transaction\\s)\\d+"),
    transaction_id = as.integer(transaction_id),
    basket = stringr::str_remove(raw_line, "^Transaction\\s+\\d+:")
  )

case15_long <- case15_raw %>%
  select(transaction_id, basket) %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = stringr::str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

case15_basket <- case15_long %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_time_per_item = sd(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_time = max(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_time = min(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    range_time = max(time, na.rm = TRUE) - min(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    cv_time = ifelse(mean(time, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                     sd(time, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
                     NA_real_),
    price_per_second = ifelse(sum(time, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                              sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
                              NA_real_),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_price = min(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_price = sd(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_3_price_share = {
      p <- sort(price, decreasing = TRUE)
      if (sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        sum(head(p, 3), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    long_pause_count = sum(time > slow_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max_price / total_price, NA_real_)
  )

case15_dept_share <- case15_long %>%
  count(transaction_id, department, name = "dept_items") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    dominant_department_share = max(dept_items) / sum(dept_items),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

case15_basket <- case15_basket %>%
  left_join(case14_dept_share, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    department_diversity_ratio = unique_departments / total_items,
    items_per_second = ifelse(total_time > 0, total_items / total_time, NA_real_),
    items_per_department = total_items / unique_departments,
    expected_time_given_size = predict(model_time, newdata = .),
    time_deviation = avg_time_per_item - expected_time_given_size,
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = .),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )

# CASE15 IF SCORE

if_case15 <- case15_basket %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    total_time,
    avg_time_per_item,
    sd_time_per_item,
    price_per_second,
    max_price,
    max_price_share,
    unique_departments
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_time_per_item = replace_na(sd_time_per_item, median(if_train$sd_time_per_item, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_per_second = replace_na(price_per_second, median(if_train$price_per_second, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

X_case15_raw <- if_case15 %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_case15 <- scale(
  X_case15_raw,
  center = attr(X_train, "scaled:center"),
  scale = attr(X_train, "scaled:scale")
)

if_case15$if_score <- predict(
  if_model,
  as.matrix(X_case15),
  type = "score"
)

# CASE14 K-MEANS DISTANCE

kmeans_case15 <- case15_basket %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    total_time,
    avg_time_per_item,
    sd_time_per_item,
    range_time,
    cv_time,
    price_per_second,
    sd_price,
    max_price_share,
    top_3_price_share,
    unique_departments,
    dominant_department_share,
    department_diversity_ratio,
    items_per_second,
    items_per_department,
    time_deviation,
    price_deviation,
    long_pause_count
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_time_per_item = replace_na(sd_time_per_item, median(kmeans_train$sd_time_per_item, na.rm = TRUE)),
    range_time = replace_na(range_time, median(kmeans_train$range_time, na.rm = TRUE)),
    cv_time = replace_na(cv_time, median(kmeans_train$cv_time, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_per_second = replace_na(price_per_second, median(kmeans_train$price_per_second, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_price = replace_na(sd_price, median(kmeans_train$sd_price, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_price_share = replace_na(max_price_share, median(kmeans_train$max_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    top_3_price_share = replace_na(top_3_price_share, median(kmeans_train$top_3_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    dominant_department_share = replace_na(dominant_department_share, median(kmeans_train$dominant_department_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    department_diversity_ratio = replace_na(department_diversity_ratio, median(kmeans_train$department_diversity_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)),
    items_per_second = replace_na(items_per_second, median(kmeans_train$items_per_second, na.rm = TRUE)),
    items_per_department = replace_na(items_per_department, median(kmeans_train$items_per_department, na.rm = TRUE)),
    time_deviation = replace_na(time_deviation, median(kmeans_train$time_deviation, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_deviation = replace_na(price_deviation, median(kmeans_train$price_deviation, na.rm = TRUE)),
    long_pause_count = replace_na(long_pause_count, 0)
  )

X_case15_kmeans_raw <- kmeans_case15 %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_case15_kmeans <- scale(
  X_case15_kmeans_raw,
  center = attr(X_kmeans, "scaled:center"),
  scale = attr(X_kmeans, "scaled:scale")
)

centers <- kmeans_model$centers

case15_distances <- apply(X_case15_kmeans, 1, function(row_vec) {
  dists <- apply(centers, 1, function(center_vec) {
    sqrt(sum((row_vec - center_vec)^2))
  })
  min(dists)
})

case15_clusters <- apply(X_case15_kmeans, 1, function(row_vec) {
  dists <- apply(centers, 1, function(center_vec) {
    sqrt(sum((row_vec - center_vec)^2))
  })
  which.min(dists)
})

cluster_sizes <- table(kmeans_model$cluster)

kmeans_case15$cluster_id <- case14_clusters
kmeans_case15$cluster_size <- as.numeric(cluster_sizes[as.character(case15_clusters)])
kmeans_case15$distance_to_centroid <- case15_distances

# FINAL CASE14 SCORE

case15_if_kmeans <- case15_basket %>%
  left_join(
    if_case15 %>% select(transaction_id, if_score),
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    kmeans_case15 %>%
      select(transaction_id, cluster_id, cluster_size, distance_to_centroid),
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    if_score_01 = percent_rank(if_score),
    distance_to_centroid_01 = percent_rank(distance_to_centroid),
    combined_ik_score =
      0.50 * if_score_01 +
      0.50 * distance_to_centroid_01
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(combined_ik_score))

top_150_if_kmeans_case15 <- case15_if_kmeans %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_if_kmeans_case15$if_score)
summary(top_150_if_kmeans_case15$distance_to_centroid)
summary(top_150_if_kmeans_case15$total_items)
summary(top_150_if_kmeans_case15$total_price)

writeLines(as.character(top_150_if_kmeans_case15$transaction_id))

write.csv(
  top_150_if_kmeans_case15,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_if_kmeans_case14.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
